messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the person's hairstyle to the one shown in the reference images, using the front and back reference views to match the hairstyle shape accurately. Use the reference images only for the hairstyle. Keep the person's identity, hair color, clothing, and all other aspects of the current video unchanged.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: I'd like to change the person's hairstyle to the one shown in the reference images. Use the reference images only for the hairstyle. Keep the person's identity, hair color, clothing, and all other aspects of the current video unchanged.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The person stands with their back to the camera, then raises their right hand to touch and adjust the hair at the back of their head, briefly turning their head to the side.","camera":"A static, medium shot from behind the subject at roughly waist-to-head height.","clothing":"A long, single-breasted coat with a beige, red, and black plaid pattern and white shirt cuffs at the wrists.","hair_color":"Black.","hairstyle":"Dark hair pulled up into a small topknot bun at the crown of the head.","identity":"A person seen from behind, with a slim build and dark skin visible at the neck and hands.","scene":"An outdoor cobblestone street in front of a dark, ornate storefront with red curtains and signs reading 'SOAP' and 'COCOA POWDER'."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The person's hair now appears pulled up into a small topknot bun at the crown in the output, matching the back reference's bun shape. The rest of the scene, clothing, action, camera, and apparent hair color remain consistent with the source.
arguments.requested_change: Change the person's hairstyle to the reference style, using the front and back reference views for shape, while keeping identity, hair color, clothing, and all other video aspects unchanged.
uncertain: The front reference shows a short, spiky, gray-tipped style, but the output is viewed mostly from behind, so the front hair shape and any gray tinting could not be verified.
